name: Approval
description: One person's yes or no to a purchase. The Purchase sample's rule creates one for each approver, and only that approver, or whoever acts for them with a substitution, may grant or refuse it. Either refreshes the purchase, which then counts its approvals again. Defined together with the Purchase sample, with DefineClasses, since each names the other.
title: approver & " on " & purchase

purchase.label: Purchase
purchase.description: The id of the purchase this answer is for.

approver.label: Approver
approver.description: The id of the person asked. Only they, or whoever acts for them, answer.

comment.label: Comment
comment.description: What the approver adds to their yes or no.

transitions.name: grant
transitions.label: Grant
transitions.description: The approver says yes, and the purchase counts its approvals again.

transitions.name: refuse
transitions.label: Refuse
transitions.description: The approver says no, and the purchase is rejected.
